_comment: Audit flags (audit_minutes.py) checked against the source PDF and found to be genuine quirks of the source document, not parser errors. Keys name the meeting (date|type|document|item), not the PDF, so they survive the city renaming or replacing a file; checked_against is the PDF the flag was checked in. Only flags NOT listed here fail the daily data update. Add an entry only after checking the PDF.
